statement.zh: 福塔莱萨晚古风纪念性填筑常用 shicra（纤维石袋），并因此保存可用于测年的植物纤维。
statement.en: Fortaleza Late Archaic monumental fills often use shicra (fiber bags of cobbles), which also preserve datable plant fiber.
